methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native directly counter the concentration pattern by building grassroots AI literacy in a defense-tech region outside traditional tech hubs, signaling distributed capability-building through community initiative.

signals.title: Virginia Tech researchers look to AI to ease difficult workplace conversations
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech developing specialized AI workplace training tools demonstrates deep technical capability concentrating in academic research centers, but commercial adoption pathways remain unclear for broader workplace distribution across rural Virginia.

signals.title: RiverStreet Networks removed from multiple broadband deployment projects in rural Virginia after years of delays
signals.signal_reading: Broadband infrastructure collapse affecting 30,000+ potential customers in rural Virginia directly undermines the connectivity foundation required for any AI adoption, reinforcing the conditions for neither depth nor distribution to materialize in underserved regions.

signals.title: From AI cameras to drones, Fairfax Co. uses new technology in policing
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax County's deployment of AI cameras and drones in policing represents deep, operationalized AI capability concentrated in Virginia's wealthiest jurisdiction with institutional capacity for advanced implementation that rural counties cannot replicate.

signals.title: How AI is changing what happens to Hampton Roads' trash - The Suffolk News-Herald
signals.signal_reading: AI integration into municipal waste management operations shows platform-delivered automation enabling functional adoption in mid-tier metros without requiring deep local AI expertise, signaling shallow-but-useful distribution through turnkey solutions.
